page.overview:
Who is Boomka Slay?

Boomka Slay was a male Force-sensitive individual. According to a Galactic Enquire publication Slay was rumored to be the son of "Yak Face," a Yarkoran. The publication was read by the Aqualish Ponda Baba, who noted this to his companion, the Dressellian Orrimaarko. The Dressellian was surprised by this, and Baba noted the lack of resemblance. Orrimaarko clarified he was enquiring if this was "canon" and added, in exasperation, the exclamation "man." Baba misunderstood these statements and pointed to Canon-Man, who was standing nearby.

Boomka Slay was mentioned in the 2023 non-canon comic story "The Light Side," within the Launchpad section of Star Wars Insider 217. Jamie Cosley wrote and illustrated the comic.
